messages:
dara: Heads-up: quick UX review of the Private setup wizard network step. When a full preflight runs the probe list is too tall on small screens. Thinking a dense single-line summary row with an expand chevron for details.

milo: Dense row sounds good. Key constraint: the primary remediation (Retry probe) must remain visible without expanding. Could be a tiny pill/button on the right.

anya: Agreed. UI idea: left icon + one-line parsed summary (e.g., 'SSH timed out (22)') + small timestamp and a primary 'Retry probe' button. Secondary actions in overflow (⋯) -> 'View remediation' / 'Copy raw output'.

colin: Accessibility notes: expand control must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Announce status updates in a scoped live region using `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the row so screen readers hear changes only for that probe.

dara: Good call. Microcopy suggestions: full: "Agent could not reach Redwood control plane. Verify SSH (port 22) and your host CIDR allowlist." Compact (mobile): "Agent unreachable — check SSH 22 & CIDR."

milo: +1. Also replace ambiguous "Help" with "View remediation" and prefer explicit "Retry probe" over just "Retry" in desktop layouts. Mobile can show the shorter label.

anya: Logs UX: show a short parsed summary in the details panel, then a collapsed raw log block behind a "Show raw output" toggle. Toggle needs `aria-expanded` and an accessible label like "Show raw probe output for SSH test".

colin: Visual priority: collapsed passing probes should be visually de-emphasized (muted text + subtle divider). Failures should be pinned open by default and get a left accent (non-color-only) — e.g., left bar + error icon + bold label. Ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1.

dara: Animation idea: a brief pulse on newly failing rows to draw attention, but only when `prefers-reduced-motion` is not enabled. Add QA check item for that.

milo: Focus behavior: when a user clicks Retry probe, keep focus on the Retry button and update the status in the live region. Do not auto-focus new elements. If a new actionable link is inserted (e.g., 'View remediation'), only shift focus if user explicitly opened it.

anya: Edge-case: when there are dozens of probes, add a sticky summary bar above the list: counts (passing / warning / failing) as small filter buttons and a primary "Run all probes" action. On mobile keep it compact: just counts + tiny filter icon.

colin: Microcopy for intermittent failures: add a short hint under the parsed summary: "Intermittent? Try from a different network or check ephemeral IPs." Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/probes#flaky-networks (placeholder).

dara: QA checklist suggestion to hand to eng: 1) scoped `aria-live` per row; 2) `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` on toggles; 3) keyboard reachability for overflow menu; 4) contrast checks; 5) animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; 6) timestamps localized and relative on client; 7) mobile truncation for copy.

aria-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.com/mock/priv-wizard-compact-987 (saved).

milo: Next steps: I'll prototype the dense row + pinned failures. Anya can draft the toggle aria labels and the QA list. Colin, can you scope the design token updates for warning/critical accents?

anya: On it — will post a short Loom of aria flows.

colin: Will update the tokens repo and ping the PR.

dara: Thanks all — sync in 25. :thumbsup:
